text:
zoe_pd: Quick sync — enterprise DP asked for a one-pager SLA + launch gates before we send invites. They care about residency, retention, incident comms, and a clear upgrade path.
carmen_security: Need to confirm KMS + approved regions. If they require HSM we should mark as "negotiable" and surface T&Cs.
dylan_eng: For pilot we can promise 99.5% hosted uptime, 30d default retention, 72h KV purge on request. Raw logs only with a data-handling addendum.
maria_ops: Ops: schedule maintenance Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Sev1 ack within 1 hour, 24h updates. 99.9% is only with reserved capacity / dedicated pool.
lucas_research: Add acceptance criteria: latency p95 < 500ms, quality regression <=3% on partner eval (we'll provide a 5-prompt quick check).
zoe_pd: Let's split must-haves vs negotiables in the invite. Must-haves = 99.5%, 30d retention, 72h purge, dashboards. Negotiables = 99.9%, raw logs, longer retention.
invite-bot: Reminder: dp-invite-template v5 updated — include onboarding checklist (NDA, onboarding call, sample prompts, eval set, POC contact).
carmen_security: Add a short safety line: "avoid sending PII in prompts; Redwood may pause traffic on safety signals."
dylan_eng: I'll draft the tech appendix (deletion flow + upgrade path) and add a one-line fallback behavior: route to compatible variant + notify partner.
maria_ops: I'll confirm maintenance windows and incident cadence and put it in the invite.
zoe_pd: Actions: Dylan = tech appendix, Carmen = security snippet, Maria = ops cadence, Lucas = 5 prompts + rubric, Zoe = finalize invite. Aim to send invites next Tue. :spiral_calendar:
